items.title: 8.2 Podon mein gaison ka tabadla (gas exchange) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.2, printed pages 180-182.

blocks.text: Stomata (wahid: stoma) podon ke tissues mein bohat chhote surakh (pores) hain jo gaison ke tabadle (gaseous exchange) ke liye zaroori hain. Yeh aam taur par patton mein hote hain magar kuch tanon (stems) mein bhi mil sakte hain. Har stoma ke gird khaas cells hote hain jinhen guard cells kehte hain; yehi surakh ko kholte aur band karte hain. Guard cells lobiya (bean) ki shakal ke hote hain aur in mein chloroplasts hote hain. Mahol ke halaat ke mutabiq guard cells khulte aur band hote hain. Stomata ka khulna aur band hona pode mein transpiration (patton se pani ka bhaap ban kar urna) ki raftar ko control karta hai.

blocks.alt: Patte ki epidermis ka satahi manzar, lehriya kinaron wale cells ka farsh. Baen khula stoma: lobiya-numa do guard cells ek doosre se door mure hue, darmiyan mein gehra adsi-numa surakh (pore). Daen band stoma: dono guard cells seedhe aur jure hue, surakh sirf ek bareek lakeer. Labels: Guard cell, Pore, Open stoma, Closed stoma.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4: Lavender ke patte par khule aur band stomata ki scanning electron micrograph (SEM) (kitab ki Figure 8.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab mein yahan electron microscope ki tasveer hai; yeh us ka khaaka hai. Guard cells mein pani bhar jaye (turgid) to woh bahar ki taraf mur jate hain aur beech mein surakh (pore) khul jata hai. Pani nikal jaye (flaccid) to woh seedhe ho kar aapas mein mil jate hain aur stoma band ho jata hai.

Din ki roshni mein stomata khul jate hain taake photosynthesis ke liye CO₂ pode mein dakhil ho sake. Stomata ka khulna zyada tar guard cells control karte hain. Raat ko roshni na hone ki wajah se photosynthesis ruk jati hai, to stomata aam taur par band ho jate hain taake pani bacha rahe. Lekin pode raat ko bhi saans (respiration) lete hain: O₂ andar lete aur CO₂ bahar nikalte hain. Raat ko stomata band hone se transpiration ke zariye pani ka ziyan kam se kam hota hai.
Stomata ka khulna aur band hona

Guard cells aise valves ki tarah kaam karte hain jo pani ke dabao (hydraulic) se chalte hain aur kai cheezon ko mehsoos karte hain (multisensory) (Fig. 8.4). Stomata ke khulne aur band hone ko samjhane ke liye do hypotheses (mafroozay, yani aisi wazahatein jo abhi jaanchi ja rahi hon) hain: starch sugar hypothesis aur K⁺ ion ka andar aana (influx).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne potassium ion ko chhote harf se “k⁺” likha hai. Potassium ka sahi nishan bara K hai: K⁺. Kitab ne yahan figure ka number bhi “Fig. 7.4” likha hai; is se murad isi chapter ki Figure 8.4 hai.

1856 mein German botanist (podon ke mahir) H. von Mohl ne kaha ke leaf epidermis (patte ki bahar wali teh) ke cells mein sirf guard cells photosynthesis karte hain aur din mein sugars banate hain. Jab guard cells mein sugar ki concentration (miqdar) barhti hai to un ka water potential gir jata hai. Pani guard cells mein aa jata hai, woh phool kar turgid ho jate hain aur stoma khul jata hai. Raat ko photosynthesis ruk jati hai; sugars ya to insoluble (pani mein hal na hone wale) starch mein badal jati hain ya respiration mein kharch ho jati hain, is liye azaad sugars kam ho jati hain. Nateeja yeh ke pani guard cells se bahar nikal jata hai aur un ka turgor pressure (andar ka dabao) khatam ho jata hai. Woh dheele (flaccid) ho jate hain aur stoma band ho jata hai. Lekin yeh tareeqa stomata ke khulne band hone ke dauran guard cells ke dabao ki tez tabdeeliyon ko poori tarah nahin samjhata.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke alfaaz “guard cells are solely responsible for photosynthesis” ka matlab yeh hai ke epidermis ke cells mein sirf guard cells ke paas chloroplasts hote hain. Patte ki zyada tar photosynthesis to mesophyll cells (palisade aur spongy) karte hain.

Stomata is tarah khulte hain ke potassium ions (K⁺) active transport (energy laga kar dhakelna) se guard cells ke andar laye jate hain. Is se guard cells ka osmotic potential kam (zyada negative) ho jata hai. K⁺ ke andar aane ki wajah se pani osmosis ke zariye guard cells mein aa jata hai; woh turgid ho jate hain aur stoma khul jata hai. Neeli (blue) roshni is kaam ko tez kar deti hai: woh guard cells ke gird mahol ko tezabi (acidic) bana deti hai, jis se K⁺ aur us ke baad pani zyada andar aata hai. Raat ko K⁺ khud ba khud (passively) guard cells se bahar nikal jata hai, pani bhi nikal jata hai, guard cells flaccid ho jate hain aur stoma band ho jata hai.

Hormones bhi stomata ke khulne band hone mein hissa lete hain. Zyada garmi mein jab patte ke cells murjhane (wilting) lagte hain to mesophyll cells ek hormone chhorte hain jise abscisic acid kehte hain. Yeh hormone guard cells mein K⁺ ka active transport rok deta hai, aur roshni aur CO₂ ki concentration ka asar bhi khatam kar deta hai. Is liye K⁺ ki pumping ruk jati hai aur stomata band ho jate hain.

Palisade tissue patte ki upper epidermis ke bilkul neeche hota hai. Yeh lambe aur aapas mein kas kar jure cells se bana hai jo chloroplasts se bharpoor hote hain. In cells ki tarteeb aisi hai ke zyada se zyada roshni jazb ho, taake poda roshni ki energy ko achhi tarah chemical energy mein badal sake.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka jumla “cells that are rich in.” par adhoora reh gaya hai; ek lafz chhoot gaya hai. Sahi jumla: palisade cells chloroplasts se bharpoor (rich in chloroplasts) hote hain.

Hawa (atmosphere) se carbon dioxide stomata ke raste patte mein diffuse hoti hai (khud ba khud phail kar andar aati hai). Andar aa kar yeh gas spongy mesophyll ki air spaces (hawa ki khali jagahon) se guzar kar palisade mesophyll cells tak pohnchti hai, jahan photosynthesis mein istemal hoti hai. Photosynthesis mein bani oxygen palisade cells se nikal kar spongy mesophyll se hoti hui wapas stomata ke raste patte se bahar nikal jati hai.

blocks.alt: Ek chhota patta jis par chokor nishan hai aur teer bara kiya hua cross-section dikhata hai. Upar se: Cuticle; Upper epidermis, chapte cells ki qatar; Palisade, chloroplasts se bhare lambe cells; Spongy, dheele gol cells aur Air space; Lower epidermis jis mein do Guard cells ke darmiyan Stoma hai; bracket Palisade aur Spongy ko Mesophyll kehta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.5: Patte ki banawat: cuticle, epidermis, palisade mesophyll, spongy mesophyll, guard cells aur stoma (kitab ki Figure 8.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gas ka rasta dekhein: CO₂ neeche wale stoma se andar aati hai, air spaces mein phailti hai aur spongy aur palisade cells tak jati hai jahan photosynthesis hoti hai. Oxygen aur pani ke bukharat (water vapour) isi raste se ulte bahar nikalte hain. Cuticle mom (wax) jaisi teh hai jo pani ka ziyan rokti hai.

blocks.prompt: Garam dopahar mein ek murjhata hua patta apne stomata band kar leta hai, halaanke roshni aur CO₂ dono stomata kholne ke haq mein hain. Aisa kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Murjhate patte ke mesophyll cells abscisic acid chhorte hain. Yeh guard cells mein K⁺ ka active transport rok deta hai. K⁺ andar na aaye to pani bhi andar nahin aata, guard cells flaccid ho jate hain aur stomata band ho jate hain. Abscisic acid ka yeh asar roshni aur CO₂ ke asar par ghalib aa jata hai, aur pode ka pani bach jata hai.

items: Stomata chhote surakh hain, zyada tar patton mein; har ek ke gird do bean-shaped guard cells hain jin mein chloroplasts hote hain. Din mein CO₂ ke liye khulte, raat ko pani bachane ke liye band hote hain.

Starch sugar hypothesis: din mein guard cells mein sugar barhti hai, water potential girta hai, pani andar aata hai. K⁺ influx: K⁺ active transport se andar, pani peeche peeche; raat ko K⁺ bahar. Murjhane par abscisic acid stomata band karwata hai.
Palisade cells upper epidermis ke neeche, chloroplasts se bhare; CO₂ stomata aur spongy mesophyll ki air spaces se un tak pohnchti hai aur O₂ isi raste bahar nikalti hai.
